items.summary: Nucor Corporation (NYSE: NUE) today announced guidance for its second quarter ending July 4, 2026. Excluding a non-cash benefit of approximately $0.20 per diluted share, described below, we expect second quarter adjusted earnings to be in the range of $4.50 to $4.60. Nucor reported net earnings of $3.23 per diluted share in the first quarter of 2026 and $2.60 per diluted share in the second quarter of 2025. Non-Cash Benefit Recorded in the Second Quarter of 2026 Included in the second quarter of 2026 non-adjusted guidance range is an estimated benefit of approximately $61 million, or $0.20 per diluted share.
